lanes.hypothesis: Does full-runtime FP32 without TF32 improve greedy AR/speculative output agreement relative to BF16 on the same sixteen questions?
lanes.scope: Numerical diagnostic, all source/draft/target/mapper weights run in the stated precision. Same BF16-fitted mapper checkpoint is cast for FP32 execution. Not a matched-precision production speed comparison across lanes.
